title: Owned the software track of the graduate program
summary: I owned the software track of the company's graduate development program. I onboarded new trainees, ran monthly connects and guided rotation choices with their line managers.
what_would_have_happened: Graduate trainees in different countries would rotate through software assignments without a mentor.
the_call: Run the track through monthly connects so every trainee knows their options.
what_i_did: Brought each new trainee into the monthly connects and worked with their line managers on next rotations.
what_changed: The program office turned to me to onboard new trainees and to guide their rotations.
